zh: 回到今早離開的岸邊沙灘
en: Taking advantage of the rising tide
The sky, about to darken, yet not quite dark
From six nautical miles away
Upon the undulating waves of the sea
Returning to the shore I left this morning

zh: 誰說只有人類才能如此 ?
en: Though our steps are small
Steps faltering along
Black and white figures swaying, unsteady
But
In the grass, upon the gravel
After all, stepping out
A road traceable in patches
Who says only humans can be so?
No need to recount it to us in detail
The salmon's road home
How arduous it is
The resolve to swim upstream against the current
How to endure with fortitude
After all
They roamed free abroad for a lifetime
Going home happens only once in a lifetime

zh: 流袓先千萬年積存的血脈
en: And we
Day after day, year after year
A lifetime spent swimming the sea in search of food
On the sand, in the grass, among the gravel
Trudging on from dawn to dusk
Unafraid of
Dangerous tides, cold wind, driving rain
Paying no heed to
Humanity's awe and mutual cherishing
Our hearts are joined
Shadow and form follow each other
Flowing with the bloodline our ancestors gathered over millions of years
Walking one's own road
Guarding one's own homeland
Passing down a promise never shaken

points.zh: 小企鵝 ( Little Penguin ) 是目前所知十八種企鵝中，體形最小的企鵝。身高33公分，體重約1公斤。因爲身體矯小，又名爲神仙企鵝 ( Fairy Penguin ) ，因爲身上披有深藍色的羽毛，又稱爲藍企鵝 ( Blue Penguin )。紐西蘭毛利人則稱呼爲 " Korora "。小企鵝主要分佈於澳州南部沿海，以及紐西蘭的北島和南島北部沿岸。數目大約有一百萬隻，以澳洲墨爾本南方的菲利普島( Phillip Island )爲最大的聚集地。
points.en: The Little Penguin is, among the eighteen penguin species currently known, the smallest in size. It stands about 33 centimeters tall and weighs approximately 1 kilogram. Because of its small size it is also called the Fairy Penguin, and because its body is covered in deep blue feathers it is also called the Blue Penguin. The Maori of New Zealand call it "Korora." The Little Penguin is found mainly along the southern coast of Australia and the coasts of the North Island and northern South Island of New Zealand. Its total population is roughly one million, with Phillip Island south of Melbourne, Australia being its largest colony.

points.zh: 小企鵝是辛勞的野生禽鳥，它們像人類一樣，日出而作，日落而息，持家育兒，百般勤苦。事實上，小企鵝在黎明前便已出海，在六浬外的深廣海域，捕魚，捉蝦，追逐烏賊等獵物，還要提防避開天敵如海豹，海狗，賊鷗等獵食者，一直到黄昏時分才洄游上岸，踩着蹣跚疲乏的脚步回家餵兒。雖說小企鵝把巢穴築在海岸邊，實際上，它們上岸後還要走一段路才到家，人們把它們傍晚整隊歸巢的行列，稱爲 " 企鵝遊行 " ( Penguin Parade )。菲利普島自然公園是頗負盛名的小企鵝觀賞景點，傍晚時分，遊人可在沙灘露天的觀賞台，看小企鵝一隻一隻浮現海灘，彼此等候，然後一隻跟隨一隻，列隊走沙灘草叢回家。
points.en: The Little Penguin is a hardworking wild bird. Like humans, it rises at dawn to work and rests at sunset, keeping house and raising its young with great toil. In fact, Little Penguins put out to sea before dawn, fishing, catching shrimp, and chasing squid and other prey in the wide, deep waters six nautical miles offshore, all while staying alert to avoid predators such as seals, sea lions, and skua gulls. Only at dusk do they swim back to shore, trudging home on tired, wobbling steps to feed their young. Although Little Penguins build their burrows near the coast, after coming ashore they still must walk some distance to reach home; people call their evening procession back to the nest the "Penguin Parade." Phillip Island Nature Park is a renowned spot for viewing Little Penguins — in the evening, visitors can sit on open-air viewing platforms on the beach and watch the penguins emerge one by one from the sea, wait for one another, then follow each other in single file across the beach and through the grass back home.
